.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.005 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-12 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=1.0

* ---- Key simulation parameters (for reference & manual editing) ----
.param VIN_voltage = 12      $ Input voltage (V)
.param VIN_Rs = 0.01      $ Source series resistance (Ohm)
.param L1_L = 0.001      $ Inductance (H)
.param L1_DCR = 0.1      $ Winding resistance (Ohm)
.param L2_L = 0.001      $ Inductance (H)
.param L2_DCR = 0.1      $ Winding resistance (Ohm)
.param Ccouple_C = 4.7e-05      $ Capacitance (F)
.param Ccouple_ESR = 0.1      $ ESR (Ohm)
.param Cout_C = 0.0001      $ Capacitance (F)
.param Cout_ESR = 0.05      $ ESR (Ohm)
.param R_LOAD_R = 10      $ Resistance (Ohm)
.param PWM_Fsw = 100000      $ Switching frequency (Hz)
.param PWM_Tsw = 1e-05      $ Switching period (s)
.param PWM_D = 0.4      $ Duty cycle
.param PWM_Vhigh = 12      $ Gate drive high level (V)
.param PWM_Vlow = 0      $ Gate drive low level (V)
.param PWM_trise = 1e-07      $ Rise time (s)
.param PWM_tfall = 1e-07      $ Fall time (s)
.param R_LOAD = 10      $ Load resistance (Ohm)
* Estimated Iload = Vout / R_LOAD  (check simulation results for actual Vout)

.model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=25 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Tt=100n Rs=0.01)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.1 Cjo=1e-11 Tt=2e-08 Bv=100 Ibv=1e-06)
VIN VIN_src 0 DC 12
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.01
VSW_SENSE n1 n_SW_dsense 0
MSW n_SW_dsense n3 0 0 nmos_model
VL1_SENSE n0 n_L1_sense 0
RL1_ESR n_L1_sense n_L1_ser 0.1
L1 n_L1_ser n1 0.001 IC=0
CL1_par n0 n1 5e-11
RL1_core n0 n1 1e+06
VL2_SENSE n2 n_L2_sense 0
RL2_ESR n_L2_sense n_L2_ser 0.1
